description.value: The Air Force Garden of Remembrance is a memorial garden within Stanley Park dedicated to Royal Canadian Air Force personnel. It offers a quiet, contemplative space nestled within one of Canada's most celebrated urban parks, easily reached by cyclists on the Stanley Park seawall or internal park roads. As part of Stanley Park, it sits within a world-class cycling destination on Vancouver's waterfront.
